policy.note: A free-text skipJustification can never downgrade a required skip. Optional skips must match a frozen rule below under the exact execution context; everything else fails closed.

required.reason: The dedicated PostgreSQL gate must execute every selected test against the live database; any skip is missing mandatory evidence (aaa_quality_contract.md 9: skips obrigatorios = 0).
A conditional database test that still skips while TEST_DATABASE_URL is available is a broken or disabled requirement, not a legitimate environment skip.

optional.reason: The test is conditionally bound to TEST_DATABASE_URL and its file is selected by the separate PostgreSQL gate (package.json scripts.test:postgres). Absent in the default unit inventory is structural, and zero-skip execution is enforced by REQ-POSTGRES-GATE-ANY when that gate runs.
